message.reasoning_content: We need to determine crimes based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: drunk driving (blood alcohol 178.27 mg/100ml > 80 mg/100ml, so intoxicated driving). Caused traffic accident with injuries (both parties injured). Also assault on police (biting, tearing uniform, causing injury). So possible crimes: (1) Dangerous driving causing traffic accident resulting in injury – under Road Traffic Safety Law, criminal liability: "危险驾驶罪" (dangerous driving) or "交通肇事罪" (traffic accident causing death or injury). Since blood alcohol > 80 mg/100ml, it's "醉酒驾驶" which is "危险驾驶罪" (dangerous driving). If caused injury, may be "交通肇事罪" (traffic accident罪) but Chinese law distinguishes: if under influence, it's dangerous driving. Actually Article 133 of Criminal Law: "在道路上驾驶机动车，追逐竞驶，或者醉酒驾驶，情节恶劣的，处拘役或者管制，并处罚金。" That's dangerous driving. Also Article 133 also includes causing traffic accidents? Wait: Article 133: "在道路上驾驶机动车追逐竞驶，或者醉酒驾驶，情节恶劣的，处拘役或者管制，并处罚金。" That's dangerous driving. For causing traffic accident with injury, Article 133 also says "因而发生重大事故，致人重伤、死亡或者使公私财产遭受重大损失的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金。" Actually that's Article 133? Might be Article 133 for dangerous driving causing accident. So crime: "危险驾驶罪" (dangerous driving). Also assault on police: "故意伤害罪" (intentional injury) or "妨害公务罪" (obstructing public duty). He bit police, causing injury to officer. That is "妨害公务罪" (obstructing public officials) which includes assaulting police. Also "故意伤害罪" because he caused injury to officer's finger. Usually biting police while resisting is "妨害公务罪" (Article 277). If injury, may be "妨害公务罪" with aggravating circumstances. So likely two crimes: dangerous driving (醉酒驾驶) and obstruction of public duty (妨害公务罪). Could also be "交通肇事罪" but given drunk driving, dangerous driving is appropriate. Provide answer format: [罪名]危险驾驶罪;妨害公务罪<eoa>
